semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Logical disjunction operator indicating alternative conditions in a declaration list regarding Beneficial Ownership status.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Connects distinct declarative clauses (i, ii, iii) within a structured form or legal document section defining criteria for identifying beneficial owners. The node represents the logical 'OR' separating mutually exclusive or alternative compliance paths/declarations.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Disambiguates the structural separator between alternative legal declarations. It ensures that the subsequent text blocks are interpreted as separate options rather than cumulative requirements.
